Sulfide ion has 2 extra electrons compared to sulphur (1 marks)

TOTAL (1 marks)

Sulfur needs to gain two electrons to have a stable electron configuration (1 marks)

TOTAL (1 marks)

…but calcium has four additional protons, resulting in greater attraction between the nucleus and electrons (1 marks)

TOTAL (3 marks)

answerHtml:
Question 18 (6 marks)

Our understanding of the atom has been developed over time through the work of scientists such J. J. Thomson and James Chadwick. Describe the contributions that each of these scientists have made to atomic theory. Your answer should briefly outline the experiments they performed, their findings, and how this information was used to develop an atomic model.

J. J. Thomson (3 marks)

Experimented with the effect of magnetic field on cathode rays. (- marks)

Discovered that beam deflected towards positive field, therefore the particles were negatively charged (1 marks)

From the amount of deflection was able to calculate the mass of the particle was significantly smaller than a single atom (1 marks)

From this information deduced the existence of electrons. Used it to develop the ‘plum pudding’ model, which had a positively charged sphere with small, negatively charged electrons embedded in it. (1 marks)

TOTAL (3 marks)

James Chadwick (3 marks)

Bombarded beryllium with alpha particles, generating a new type of radiation. This radiation interacted with paraffin wax, generating protons.

(1 marks)

New particles were unattracted to magnetic field, therefore uncharged (0.5 marks)

Calculated mass of new particles as being similar to mass of protons (0.5 marks)

From this information deduced the existence of neutrons in the nucleus of atoms (1 marks)

TOTAL (3 marks)
